title: Blades & Banners: Two Fronts
shortDescription: Wield the blade above. Command your army below. Reclaim a fractured realm.
description: Fight as a Dawnward hero on the upper ridge while your soldiers wage a real-time battle in the valley below. Defeat scouts, raiders, brutes and assassins to earn gold, then recruit a balanced army of swordsmen, archers, shieldbearers, priests, knights and siege golems. Reclaim five lands, defeat Marshal Veyr, and strengthen your army with permanent campaign upgrades.
controls: Desktop: WASD or arrow keys to move and face; Space or left-click on the ridge to attack; Shift to dodge; 1–6 or click cards to recruit; Escape to pause.
Mobile: move with the left joystick, hold the sword button to attack, tap dodge, and tap recruitment cards. Both fronts remain visible; landscape is recommended.
saveNote: Campaign unlocks, best star ratings, fastest victories, campaign marks, upgrades and audio settings save locally on this device.
coverAlt: An original blue-caped Dawnward commander stands above two battlefields, as blue and crimson armies clash between stone strongholds.
